A '''Great Hunt''' was held by [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jewl'a Nightbringer]] emerged victorious in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|competition]]. The former [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]]-turned [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Tarro Blood]] also competed, but was brutally beaten almost to the point of [[Death/Legends|death]] by his fellow competitors due to his superior attitude.
